benchmark: ReplicaSSG ground-truth object crop, cross-view association, and scene-graph node impact

dataset.proposal_source: Replica semantic mesh face object IDs raycast at local Replica RGB sequence camera poses
dataset.caption_note: ReplicaSSG supplies object categories and scene relationships, not reference object captions. CLIP-family models rank label text; they do not generate captions.

measurement.primary: macro AP for each observed Replica category text query retrieving matching GT object views from the full observation bank
measurement.secondary: zero-shot label accuracy; leave-one-view-out cross-view instance retrieval; scene-graph node identity and oracle-predicate triplet recall
measurement.graph_interpretation: The relation labels are ground truth and held fixed. The graph score isolates propagation of CLIP-based object association errors into scene-graph nodes and edge triplets; it is not a predicate-generation score.

inputs.ground-truth-padded-box: GT semantic instance mask-derived box with 20-pixel context
inputs.ground-truth-mask-isolated: same box and pixels outside its GT instance mask filled with this model's processor mean RGB, which normalizes to approximately zero
inputs.ground-truth-native-roi: FG-CLIP2-only supplemental input: the full source RGB frame and oracle GT box are passed through FG-CLIP2's native RoIAlign feature API, paired with walk_type=box text embeddings; this is separate from the direct shared-crop pipeline comparison
